name: ledger
summary: Append-only to-do list where an item cannot be closed without proof.

env.LEDGER_PATH: optional: use this file instead of $HUBKIT_HOME/state/ledger.jsonl
env.HUBKIT_BANNER_EXTRAS: optional: a .py file whose prompt_lines(session_id, cwd) adds lines to the banner (default: banner_extras.py next to the hook)

needs: macOS or Linux (uses fcntl; Windows needs WSL)
